item.title: Westmoreland tractor-trailer crash leaves one dead
item.description: An early-morning collision involving two tractor-trailers in the town of Westmoreland has left one person dead and another injured, New York State Police have said.

item.title: New York tax returns feature new child credits and inflation refund requirements
item.description: New Yorkers filing their 2025 taxes should be aware of the new requirements and updated credits, such as the Empire State Child Credit and the inflation refund checks, while the IRS may be difficult to reach due to reduced staff and call center hours.

item.title: New York files lawsuit against President Trump
item.description: The New York Attorney General's office has continued its legal battle with the Trump administration. On Thursday, Attorney General Letitia James filed a new lawsuit alongside 21 other states.
